# CDS: Character Development Hub

_ Create individual Character Development Sheets as child issues.  Every main character should have one.  Secondary characters may or may not have their own Character Development Sheet.  Tertiary characters will usually be combined into one or more Character Development Sheets based on some sensible grouping. _
